what: A giant title wider than its box (field name·footer phrase) slides left by the overflow amount and returns, endlessly — one pass takes 4ms per 1px of text width, with an ease-in-out round trip. If it fits the box it stays still. With look: fade the right end fades out (the original masks toward the side panel)

options.[data-fx-part=text]: Title text to scroll (required) — can also be a row of photo slots instead of text
options.speed: Travel time per 1px of text width (ms), default 4
options.dur: One-way travel time (seconds) — if given, this duration is used instead of speed regardless of width (Brand photo row 15)
options.ease: Curve (css), default ease-in-out — photo rows use linear
options.pause: On hover, it stays paused in place while the pointer is over it or focus is inside
options.look: the fade side softly masks the right 25%

use: Very long field name title
